Chomp!

Delicious!

So once she starts rampaging...

That's normal when using great power.\nIf that's the case,\nwe might find a thread toward a countermeasure...

No, her heading won't bring her here.\nWhich means...
She found [MERU] and she's heading there!
She found [NOEL] and she's heading there!
We should stall her\nso she doesn't provoke anything rashly.
Right. Everyone, move out!
Fufufu, revenge really\ngets me fired up! Fun, fun!

You're not getting past me!
Oh my?\nCame to get in Mii's way again?\nAhaha! Thanks for trying, weaklings!
Ahaha! You're stronger than before!\nNew gear?
Like 'did you get a haircut?'...
No. The gear didn't change.\nWe've grown stronger through our battles so far.
I mean, we've been fighting nonstop.\nThe Dark Army, Eve,\nyou guys!
Hee! Interesting!\nWhen we first met, you were all scared\nand shaking in your boots!
Now you're totally different!\nMii's feeling all tingly with excitement!
What is she, a legendary Super Something, nyu!
Not yet, not yet! Entertain me more!
Hmm, still not enough.\nThis isn't fun at aaal!
As expected, not easy.
It's like eating rice\ngrain by tiny grain?\nNot tasty, and it doesn't fill me up!
I-I see...
What are you doing admiring the enemy!?\nThough I get it!
Maybe I'll use that one sometime?
Hype it up more!\nNo holding back! Hurry!
Tactics? What tactics!
Simple is best!
I don't hate that way of thinking.
C'mon, if you don't try harder\nI'll go visit the monsterr?
You're still annoying!!
You fickle brat! You're a nuisance!!
The fickle king's daily special attack!\nJust kidding!\nHahaha, bow before meee!
Aww...
Did we get her...?
Don't jinx it, nyu.
Geez, fine!\nI was saving it for the real show, but\nI guess I'll get serious!

Huh? My fault!?\nAnd don't call me 'Usada'!
Ahaha! Round two!
Bad! High-energy reaction approaching!\nIt's coming!
Huh?\nI thought she'd rest a little longer.\nWell, whatever! Let's play!
Mugyuu...
She hasn't grown at all, nyu.
Bold, or rather...

That she's still alive is worthy of amazement.
I wonder whyy? I'm telling Mommy!

I see. That's why she goes after\n[MERU] first.
I see. That's why she picks fights\nwith [NOEL].
Enough about Mie!\nThe problem starts now!\nWe have to escape again!
They're back!
...Everyone, can you somehow\nhold out for just 2 minutes?
You have an idea?
Half of it's a hunch! But if we\nlast that long, it'll work out... probably!\nWhat do you say?
I can't offer an alternative.\nWe're in!
If you say hold out 2 minutes, I'll hold out!
Alright! Everyone, run for it!
Roger!

GROOOOOH!\nOOOOHHH!\nOOOH!!
GROOOOOH!\nOOOOHHH!\nOOOH!!

Tesla's handy...

It's Charles!
